0022600088.text: The Raptors open their 2026-27 season at home against a Chicago team that has also not yet played a game this season, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Toronto a 75% win chance. Brandon Ingram is out after Achilles surgery, and ten Raptors are listed as day-to-day: Chucky Hepburn, Collin Murray-Boyles, Immanuel Quickley, Ja'Kobe Walter, Jakob Poeltl, Jamal Shead, Kawhi Leonard, Nate Bittle, RJ Barrett and Scottie Barnes. Chicago's day-to-day players are Isaac Okoro, Nic Claxton, Tobe Awaka and Zach Collins, and the Raptors won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, most recently 139-109 in Chicago on March 18, 2026, while the 2026-27 series has no games yet.
